scope: Full reconciliation of every editorial/incoming file on main; exact id and url comparisons against current feed and imported editorial records.
countSemantics: Counts are appearances across incoming files, not unique IDs or unique ID/URL pairs. Feed-exact appearances overlap editorial-exact appearances.

structuralCheck.optionalFieldNote: Eight legacy incoming snapshots omit nextSteps; scripts/editorial.py does not require nextSteps, so these are not validator failures.
structuralCheck.equivalentCheck: Each of the 133 JSON files was parsed and each id/url compared literally against main feed and editorial maps; no ID/URL conflicts or unknown identities were found.

seenOnlyDisposition.action: Keep in original incoming files and this pending report; do not create replacement identities or import without an exact current feed ID/URL match.
